def.micro: tasks you do for a job
def.short: the things you do at your job or school, or the effort you put in
def.long: The activity of doing tasks, usually at a job or at school. It is uncountable: say 'a lot of work' or 'some work', never 'works' or 'a work'.

grammar.pattern: a lot of work / go to work

examples.en: I have a lot of work today.
She goes to work by bus.
Great work, everyone! See you tomorrow.
examples.tr: Harika iş çıkardınız, arkadaşlar! Yarın görüşürüz.

tr.note: 'Work' sayılamaz: 'a work' ya da 'works' demeyiz (sanat eseri anlamı hariç: 'a work of art'). İş yeri ya da meslek için 'job' kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: I have many works to do.
mistakes.right: I have a lot of work to do.
mistakes.why: 'Work' sayılamaz; çoğul eki almaz ve 'many' yerine 'a lot of / much' ile gelir.

mistakes.right: What is your job? / What do you do?
mistakes.why: Meslek sormak için 'job' ya da 'What do you do?' kullanılır; 'work' yapılan işi genel olarak anlatır.

quiz.cloze: I can't come out tonight. I have too much ______ to do.

def.micro: a short journey to a place
def.short: a journey to a place and back again, for fun or work
def.long: A journey to a place and back again, usually for a short time, for pleasure or for work. A trip can last a day or a few days.

examples.en: We took a day trip to the lake.
How was your trip to Izmir?
He is away on a business trip this week.

tr.note: 'Trip' = gidip dönülen kısa gezi ya da yolculuk. 'Travel' sayılamaz ve genel olarak seyahat etmeyi anlatır. Fiil olarak 'trip' ise 'takılıp düşmek' demektir.

mistakes.wrong: I made a travel to Antalya.
mistakes.right: I took a trip to Antalya.
mistakes.why: 'Gezi yapmak' için 'take / go on a trip' denir; 'travel' sayılamaz, 'a travel' denmez.
Yolcu uğurlarken 'Have a nice trip!' denir; 'travel' bu kalıpta kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: We're planning a weekend ______ to the mountains.

def.micro: go from one place to another
def.short: go from one place to another, especially far away
def.long: To go from one place to another, especially over a long distance. As a verb or an uncountable noun, it names the act of going; for one short journey, say 'trip'.

examples.en: I travel to work by train.
She loves to travel and see new places.
examples.tr: Seyahat etmeyi ve yeni yerler görmeyi seviyor.

examples.en: We traveled around Italy for two weeks.

tr.note: 'Travel' fiil ya da sayılamayan isimdir ('Travel is expensive'). Tek bir gezi için 'trip' denir. İngiliz yazımı 'travelled', Amerikan yazımı 'traveled'.

mistakes.wrong: I travel with the bus every day.
mistakes.right: I travel by bus every day.
mistakes.why: Araç belirtirken 'by + araç' kullanılır (by bus, by train); 'with' kullanılmaz.

mistakes.wrong: I made a travel last week.
mistakes.right: I went on a trip last week.
mistakes.why: 'Travel' sayılamaz, 'a travel' denmez; tek bir gezi için 'trip' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: I love to ______ and meet people from other countries.

def.short: real or true, not what people think, say, or plan
def.long: Real or true; used to say what is really so, not what was planned, guessed, or said. It does NOT mean 'current' (güncel): for that, use 'current'.

examples.en: The actual price was higher than the price online.
What was the actual reason for his decision?
The photo looks nice, but the actual room is small.
examples.tr: Fotoğraf güzel görünüyor ama gerçek oda küçük.

tr.note: Türkçe 'aktüel' = güncel, şu anki. İngilizce 'actual' ise 'gerçek, asıl' demektir. 'Güncel' için 'current' kullanılır. 'Actually' (aslında) kartına da bak.

mistakes.wrong: The actual situation of the economy is difficult. (= güncel)
mistakes.right: The current situation of the economy is difficult.

mistakes.wrong: Check the actual news about the weather.
mistakes.right: Check the latest news about the weather.
mistakes.why: 'Aktüel haberler' = 'current / latest news'; 'actual' bu anlamda kullanılmaz.

tr.mnemonic: Aktüel (güncel) = current. Actual = gerçek: 'act' = eylem, fiilen olan.

quiz.cloze: He says he is thirty, but his ______ age is forty.

def.micro: at last, after a long time
def.short: finally, after a long time or after many things happened
def.long: In the end, after a long time or after many things have happened. It does NOT mean 'possibly' (olası): for that, use 'possibly' or 'perhaps'.

examples.en: We got lost, but eventually we found the hotel.
She worked hard and eventually became a doctor.
examples.tr: Çok çalıştı ve sonunda doktor oldu.

examples.en: The bus was late, but it eventually arrived.
examples.tr: Otobüs geç kaldı ama sonunda geldi.

tr.note: Türkçe 'eventüel' = olası, muhtemel. İngilizce 'eventually' ise 'sonunda' demektir ve kesin gerçekleşen bir sonu anlatır. 'Muhtemelen' için 'probably' ya da 'possibly' kullanılır.

mistakes.wrong: Eventually, I may come to your party. (= muhtemelen)
mistakes.right: I may possibly come to your party.
mistakes.why: 'Eventüel' (olası) için 'possibly / perhaps' kullanılır; 'eventually' kesin bir sonu anlatır.

tr.mnemonic: Event-ually: olaylar yaşandıktan sonra gelen son. 'Eventüel' (olası) tuzağına düşme.

quiz.cloze: It took many hours, but she ______ finished the book.

def.short: thinking carefully and making practical, wise choices
def.long: Showing good judgment and making choices that are practical and wise. It does NOT mean 'sensitive' (hassas, kolay etkilenen): for that, use 'sensitive'.

examples.en: That's a sensible idea. Let's do it.
examples.tr: Bu mantıklı bir fikir. Hadi yapalım.

examples.en: It's sensible to take an umbrella today.
She is a sensible girl and never takes silly risks.
examples.tr: Aklı başında bir kız; saçma riskler almaz.

tr.note: Türkler 'sensible' ile 'sensitive' kelimelerini sık karıştırır. 'Sensible' mantıklı, akıllıca davranan demektir. Türkçedeki 'hassas, duyarlı' ise İngilizcede 'sensitive'dir.

mistakes.wrong: He is a very sensible person. He cries easily. (= hassas)
mistakes.right: He is a very sensitive person. He cries easily.
mistakes.why: Hassas, kolay etkilenen için 'sensitive'; 'sensible' mantıklı demektir.

mistakes.wrong: My skin is sensible to the sun.
mistakes.right: My skin is sensitive to the sun.
mistakes.why: Cilt güneşe karşı hassastır: 'sensitive'. 'Sensible' bu anlamda kullanılmaz.

tr.mnemonic: Sensible: 'good sense' (sağduyu) sahibi. Sensitive: duyarlı, hassas.

quiz.cloze: Wearing a coat in winter is a ______ idea.

def.short: know that something is there because your eyes show it to you
def.long: To notice or know that something is there with your eyes, without trying. You see something by chance, but you watch something that moves, on purpose.

examples.en: I can see the sea from my window.
Did you see Ali at the party last night?
examples.tr: Dün gece partide Ali'yi gördün mü?

examples.en: I can't see without my glasses.

tr.note: 'See' = görmek (göz kendiliğinden görür); 'watch' = izlemek (dikkatle, bir süre bakmak); 'look at' = bakmak. Genelde 'can' ile: 'I can see'. Düzensiz: see - saw - seen.

mistakes.wrong: I'm seeing a bird in the tree.
mistakes.right: I can see a bird in the tree.
mistakes.why: Görme fiili 'see' şimdiki anda genelde -ing almaz; 'can see' kullanılır.
Televizyon gibi hareketli bir şeyi bir süre izlemek için 'watch'; 'see' bir anda görmektir.

quiz.cloze: I can't ______ the board from the back of the room.

def.micro: look at something for a time
def.short: look at something that moves or changes, and give it your attention
def.long: To look at something that moves or changes, such as a film, a match, or a child, and give it your attention for some time. You watch on purpose; you see by chance.

examples.en: We watch a film together every Friday.
I like to watch the news in the morning.
She watched the kids play in the park.

tr.note: 'Watch' = izlemek, seyretmek (dikkatle ve bir süre). Televizyon, film, maç için 'watch'; resim ya da tabela için 'look at' kullanılır. 'Watch' isim olarak 'kol saati' demektir.

mistakes.why: TV izlemek için 'watch'; 'look' ancak 'look at' kalıbıyla kullanılır.
Televizyon gibi hareketli şeyleri bir süre izlemek için 'watch' kullanılır; 'see' kısa bir bakıştır.

quiz.cloze: He sat on the sofa and ______ TV all evening.
